_comment: Example layer-style config for make_floor_texture.py. Patterns are case-insensitive shell globs on the DXF layer name (after INSERT explosion, entities on layer 0 take their INSERT's layer). 'drop' wins over the groups; a layer matching no group is dropped. The first group is drawn on top. Widths are line widths in metres; intensity is the grey value 0-255 (the Unity underlay maps it to opacity).
